text: ポケモンが　そだって　しぜんに　おぼえる　わざの　ほかに　いつでも　わざを　おしえられる　すごい　マシンの　ことさ！

structure.jp: ポケモンが　そだって
しぜんに　おぼえる　わざの　ほかに
structure.en: apart from the moves they learn naturally

structure.jp: いつでも　わざを　おしえられる
structure.en: that can teach a move at any time

structure.jp: すごい　マシンの　ことさ！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンが　そだって　しぜんに　おぼえる　わざ
patterns.explanation: A whole phrase ending in a verb sits right before a thing and tells which one it is. ポケモンが　そだって　しぜんに　おぼえる　わざ = 'moves that Pokémon learn naturally as they grow'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending means 'can do'. Here it also describes the machine that follows. わざを　おしえられる　マシン = 'a machine you can teach moves with'.

patterns.name: 〜のほかに
patterns.explanation: のほかに after a thing means 'besides that thing'. わざの　ほかに = 'apart from the moves'.
